name: print-social-blue-hiring-graphic-designer-post-with-responsibilities-panels
title: Blue 'We Are Hiring! Graphic Designer' post with a man on a yellow armchair between glass responsibilities and requirements panels
whatItIs: A square bright blue post with a white and yellow headline, a smiling man with headphones working on a laptop in a yellow armchair, flanked by two glass panels with orange-yellow headers: 'Responsibilities' (Social media posts, Branding material…) and 'Requirements' (Strong creativity, Time management…), plus WhatsApp and email.
whatItMeans: Friendly and informative; flanking panels explain the role while the relaxed pose sells the culture.
techniques: Flank the subject with two symmetrical info panels.
Match the chair colour to the accent.
Use glass panels with coloured header tabs.

vocabulary.definition: Equal panels on both sides of a centre subject.
A coloured strip titling a panel.
